question: Who among the following inaugurated 75 Digital Banking Units (DBU) in October 2022 in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __PM Narendra Modi.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PM Narendra Modi will dedicate 75 Digital Banking Units (DBUs) to the nation on 16 Oct 2022.
 
• As part of the Union budget speech for 2022-23, the Finance Minister had announced the setting up of the 75 DBUs in 75 districts of the country to commemorate the 75 years of independence of the country.
 
• The DBUs are being set up to ensure benefits of digital banking reach all corners of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Important Current Affairs Related to PM Narendra Modi:​ 

 
 
• PM Modi inaugurated Phase 1 of Modi Shaikshanik Sankul, an educational complex for needy students in Ahmedabad, Gujarat on 10th Oct 2022.
 
• PM Modi on 9th Oct 2022 declared Modhera in Gujarat's Mehsana district as India's first 24x7 solar-powered village.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Akshaya Patra Foundation’s new midday meal kitchen in Varanasi on 7 July 2022.
 
• PM Narendra Modi on 7 July 2022 inaugurated 'Akhil Bhartiya Shiksha Samagam' on implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) in Varanasi.
 
• PM Modi laid the foundation stone and inaugurated several projects worth 33000 crore rupees in Bengaluru on 20 June 2022.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated ‘Kranti Gatha’ on 14 June 2022.
 
• PM Modi on 10 June 2022 inaugurated the headquarters of the Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe) at Bopal in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 
 

ca:T
